protocol.holdout: chronological later segment; all four underlying source/receipt clocks must be on or after the split; no holdout fitting or threshold search
protocol.eligiblePairs: strict same-state, same-party statewide Senate and Governor contracts from frozen market metadata; no candidate/party substitution
protocol.factor: fixed equal-share beta=1 across every state/party pair; only the residual center and scale are fitted from development-only synchronized snapshots; development OLS hedge fits are recorded as diagnostics and never select or size trades
protocol.signal: fixed residual threshold |z| >= 2; long the cheap YES and buy one share of the rich contract NO; only threshold transitions are candidates
protocol.entryAndExit: both legs priced at their post-latency top-of-book sides; one displayed share must be available on each required level; equal one-share sizing; zero fees; no actual order or fill inference
protocol.adverseStress: one tick adverse per leg on entry and exit; no tuning or selection on held-out results
protocol.signalOverlap: one pair position at a time; block new signals until the 5s close mark, and censor the rest of a continuity segment if that close cannot be established

universe.excluded: House and other nonstatewide contracts, state/party groups missing either office, and any contract not matching exact statewide title grammar

heldOutResidualSummary.interpretation: The fixed |z|>=2 rule produced no signal if the threshold-exceedance count is zero; no trade markout is defined for an empty strategy.

priorOlsDiagnostic.note: Preserved initial OLS-only pass; it had no eligible model or trade marks. It was not used to tune the fixed equal-share comparator.

priorSameSourceReplay.note: Prior exact-source equal-share replay retained as a regeneration diagnostic; not used for model fitting or selection.

limitations: A same-state party YES contract in two different offices is a correlation hedge, not an arbitrage identity or guaranteed payout relation.
The continuous regression hedge ratio may not be an accepted live order quantity; reported paired P&L is a normalized counterfactual quote markout, not account return.
Both legs must be independently marketable; no actual fills, atomic two-market execution, queue position, partial-fill hedging, or synchronized order acceptance are proven.

There are 25 state-level clusters, grouping party-specific pairs by state, and one captured session. Per-pair and aggregate markouts are diagnostic, serially dependent, and do not establish persistent alpha or profitability; state outcomes can also share nationwide shocks.
Only top-of-book displayed quantity is used; deeper capacity, portfolio funding, market impact, settlement exceptions, and competition orders are not modeled.
